tool_args.rationale: All five pilot gains y/u_now are positive, but the H=20 probe gives a gain of about -0.467. A fast positive component opposed by a slower negative component can explain both regimes. Fit the four parameters jointly to all six observations and test the result on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The exponential factor is positive, so this model cannot account for both positive pilot gains and the negative H=20 gain with a fixed amplitude.
The acquired probe already resolved the observed mechanism disagreement at the forecast horizon.
Fit and confirm the four-parameter law on the available evidence before paying for finer trajectory measurements.
